result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant card and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off on the right edge, truncating both the restaurant image and name text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container shows a consistent peek of the next card to signal scrollability, or adjust card sizing/padding so the truncation is intentional and visually clean rather than appearing broken.

issues.description: The last category filter pill in the horizontal filter row (after 'Healthy') is partially visible and cut off, with no visual indicator that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient overlay on the right edge of the filter row to indicate horizontal scrollability, making it clear to users that more categories are available.
